failedGraders: judge:A mobile "kit builder" formSheet was just added under packages/app/expo/app/(sheets)/kit-form/ with an opener on the home tab. Verify ALL of: (a) NAV-MODAL — the sheet is registered in app/_layout.tsx via Stack.Screen name="(sheets)/kit-form" with EXPLICIT presentation 'formSheet' (plus headerShown: false and a contentStyle background); the opener under app/(tabs)/home/ pushes the route via router.push with the typed pathname — no web dialog/store pattern carried over; successful submit pairs Haptics with router.back() (the formSheet dismissal); the sheet self-gates with <Protected> (it sits outside the gated (tabs) group); the kit-type param round-trips through useTypedSearchParams(schema) from @/lib/typed-route with EVERY schema field .default()-ed and the type field typed by the SDK ProductCostType values (a garbage deep link renders defaults, never crashes), and the param seeds the form's defaultValues. (b) FORM-SUBSCRIBE + DISC-UNION — exactly ONE useForm owns the whole draft, created by the sheet screen, with validators { onChange } over a schema derived from createKitMutationRequestSchema with the UI-only editing fields merged via .and(z.object({...})); children (editor, items list, rows, picker) receive the form as a typed prop whose type comes from a never-invoked inference helper in -types.ts (ReturnType<typeof _infer...>) — no React Context, no Zustand mirror of field values, no prop-drilling of values; each added-item ROW subscribes via form.Subscribe with a selector returning a PRIMITIVE 3-mode discriminant (idle / this-row-editing / other-row-editing) so editor keystrokes do not re-render rows; tapping a row enters edit mode through batched form.setFieldValue calls; the editor branches its action between add-new and save-edits off that editing discriminant; the final submit re-parses with the bare createKitMutationRequestSchema (stripping the UI-only fields) and sends result.data; the create button's disabled gate derives from safeParse inside a form.Subscribe. (e) LAYOUT — colocated components live at -components/<Name>/index.tsx with NAMED exports only; the store under -stores/; no flat or _-prefixed colocated files. Inspect the new files under app/(sheets)/kit-form/, plus app/_layout.tsx, app/(tabs)/home/ and locales/{pt,en}.json. The pre-existing sheets (edit-profile, devices) are out of scope.
